summary.text: Wren Williams is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 47th District since 2022.
The district covers Carroll, Floyd and Patrick counties, part of Henry County and the City of Galax.
The House profile lists Wren Williams's occupation as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Wren Williams was born in Christiansburg, Virginia.
The profile lists Patrick County High School, a B.A. from Hampden-Sydney College (2011) and an M.A. and J.D. from Samford University, AL (2014).

The profile lists Stuart Presbyterian Church, Patrick County Young Professionals, board service at Patrick Henry Community College and the Patrick Henry Education Foundation, and service as chairman of the Patrick County Republican Committee.
Wren Williams serves on the Courts of Justice, Labor and Commerce, and Health and Human Services committees.
